h1: The 1 Boutique Hotel — a small hotel in central Thong Sala you can walk to straight off the ferry
intro: If you're arriving on Koh Phangan and want somewhere you can walk to from the pier and check straight in — no taxi across the island required — The 1 Boutique Hotel is a tiny boutique hotel of around 10 rooms right in the heart of Thong Sala, the island's main town and ferry hub · It's a 5–10 minute walk to the pier, Phantip night market, the walking street, restaurants and supermarkets · Rooms are clean with cold AC, a fridge and free Wi-Fi, starting from around ฿750/night in normal season — a great-value pick for your first or last night before catching a boat.

body.html: The 1 Boutique Hotel isn't a sprawling beachfront resort — it's a small boutique hotel of around 10 rooms in the middle of Thong Sala town, the main town where every Koh Phangan ferry docks · Its selling point is location, pure and simple · You can walk from Thong Sala Pier and Raja Ferry Port to the door in about 5–10 minutes, with no connecting taxi and no late-night ride across the island · For anyone arriving late by boat or with an early onward flight, being able to wheel your bag to the room in minutes is comfort that's hard to put a price on.

The rooms are simple but clean and well air-conditioned, with a flat-screen TV, a small fridge, a kettle and free Wi-Fi that many reviews say is genuinely fast · They're fairly compact — built for a good night's sleep and heading out, rather than lounging all day · Set your expectations correctly: this is a budget boutique hotel, not a 5-star room · Some reviews mention small rooms, the odd stain on the linen, or ants on occasion, which points to housekeeping that isn't perfectly consistent room to room — for a longer stay, ask for fresh linen and an extra clean now and then.

"Got off the boat in the evening, wheeled my bag less than ten minutes and I was in the room — showered and walked back out to eat at the night market. For a first night on the island, brilliant value."

What surrounds the hotel is Thong Sala, where everything is within walking distance · Phantip night market (the island's famous night market) is around 200 metres away, the walking street a 4–5 minute stroll · There are cafés like The Fat Cat, Pizza Chiara and plenty of restaurants on foot · Supermarkets, ATMs, scooter-rental shops and ferry-ticket offices are all close by · This kind of location is perfect if you haven't rented a scooter yet, or want to use Thong Sala as a base before fanning out to the beaches.

Two things to be straight about · First, noise — being in the middle of town means traffic, plus sound from nearby bars and the street at night, and some guests report early-morning road noise · If you're a light sleeper, bring earplugs or ask for a room away from the street · Second, inconsistent front-desk service — plenty of reviews praise helpful staff who sort out transport and are friendly, but a few complain about a cool welcome or unclear communication at check-in · Worth knowing too: the front desk is open 8:00–21:00, with no after-hours check-in, so flag a late arrival in advance.

The overall scores reflect a well-located, good-value, no-frills hotel — Tripadvisor 3.6/5, roughly #83 of 188 B&Bs/inns on Koh Phangan, with booking platforms scoring it in the low-to-mid 7–8 range · Guests who come expecting a clean, convenient room at a budget price tend to leave happy; those expecting a quiet boutique-resort feel may find it doesn't match the picture · This is a transit/town hotel rather than the destination of the trip.

In short, The 1 Boutique Hotel stands out for its central Thong Sala location within walking distance of the pier, night market and restaurants, at a price that's genuinely light · It suits travellers who've just stepped off the ferry and want to check straight in, anyone using their first or last night on the island, and solo travellers or couples who value convenience over a sea view · But if you've come to Koh Phangan to wake up to the ocean, want a pool or a quiet resort vibe, this isn't it — choose a beachfront stay at Srithanu, Haad Yao or Thong Nai Pan instead.

A tip from reading the real reviews: ask for a room off the main road and further inside to cut the night-time noise · If you'll reach the island after 21:00, message the hotel ahead since there's no late check-in · Renting a scooter from a shop near the hotel makes hopping to the other beaches far easier — and don't miss Phantip night market in the evening, just a few steps away.

highlights.title: Night market & dining on foot
highlights.text: Phantip night market is around 200 m away; the walking street, cafés, a pizzeria, supermarkets and ATMs are all within a short stroll of the hotel.

honestSummary: The 1 Boutique Hotel is a small in-town boutique hotel for travellers who want a walk-to-the-pier location, a clean room and a budget price — ideal as a transit stay for the first or last night on the island, or a base in Thong Sala · Just accept that there's town noise, service can be inconsistent, and there's no sea view or pool.
honestChecks: If you came to Koh Phangan to wake up to the sea and a pool — The 1 is in town, not on the beach, with no pool → choose a beachfront resort at Srithanu, Haad Yao or Thong Nai Pan instead.
If you're a light sleeper — central Thong Sala has traffic and bar noise at night → ask for a room off the main road and bring earplugs.
If you'll arrive on the island after 21:00 — the front desk is open 8:00–21:00 with no late check-in → message the hotel ahead or plan to check in the next morning.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — The 1 Boutique Hotel Koh Phangan

faq.q: Where is The 1 Boutique Hotel and how do I get there?
faq.a: The 1 Boutique Hotel is at 209/3 Moo 1 in Thong Sala, the main town of Koh Phangan · It's a 5–10 minute walk from Thong Sala Pier and Raja Ferry Port, with no taxi needed · The night market, restaurants, supermarkets and ATMs are all within walking distance, making it ideal for travellers who've just stepped off the ferry.

faq.q: How much does The 1 Boutique Hotel cost and what rooms are there?
faq.a: In normal season it starts at around ฿750/night for a Standard Double · A Superior room is around ฿950 and a Deluxe around ฿1,200 · All rooms are air-conditioned with a TV, fridge and free Wi-Fi · Prices swing with the season and full-moon nights, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Who is The 1 Boutique Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's ideal for ferry travellers, anyone using their first or last night on the island, and travellers who prioritise location and price · You can walk to the pier, night market and restaurants · It's not for those wanting a beachfront resort, a pool, or a quiet setting for a longer relaxing stay.

faq.q: Does The 1 Boutique Hotel have a pool or beach?
faq.a: No · The 1 is a boutique hotel in central Thong Sala, not beachfront and without a pool · If you want the sea outside your room or a swimming pool, choose a beachfront stay at Srithanu, Haad Yao or Thong Nai Pan · This hotel is about a convenient in-town location rather than a view.

faq.q: Is late check-in possible, and is it noisy?
faq.a: The front desk is open 8:00–21:00 with no after-hours check-in, so flag a late arrival in advance · On noise, being in the centre of town means some traffic and bar noise at night · We'd suggest a room off the main road and earplugs if you're a light sleeper.

faq.q: How far in advance should I book?
faq.a: For full-moon nights (once a month) and the Dec–Feb high season, book 3–6 weeks ahead, since the hotel has only around 10 rooms and its near-pier location is in demand · Otherwise 1–2 weeks is fine · Pick a free-cancellation rate if your plans aren't firm yet.
